entities.summary: Suanhild, also spelt Swanhild, Svanhild, or Schwanhild, was abbess of Essen Abbey from 1058 until her death. She oversaw the construction of a church and contributed works of art to the Essen Cathedral treasury. In 1073, Suanhild donated the collegiate church of Essen-Stoppenberg as a parish chapel. She also added a reliquary containing the arm of St. Basil to the cathedral treasury.
